title: CoinRun dynamics offline-latent reference repair
question: Can deterministic offline 16.6M tokenizer encoding preserve the CR-DYN-0010 CoinRun data/action protocol while removing repeated encoder work from every dynamics update?
reason: CR-DYN-0010 processed raw RGB records and re-ran the frozen tokenizer encoder inside every training update. The first 10,000-update validation required about 43 minutes of steady-state training and exposed a 13-hour projected 200k schedule. The public OpenDreamer dynamics recipe trains on pre-tokenized latent ArrayRecords instead.
hypothesis: Pre-tokenizing each 160-frame record once will preserve action, reward and terminal alignment, retain the same reward-biased crop semantics, and materially improve dynamics update throughput without changing the model, optimizer, token budget or final raw-RGB evaluation protocol.
falsification: Reject the infrastructure hypothesis if any latent record differs from its raw source in action/reward/terminal alignment, if reward-biased cropping is not preserved, if the latent run cannot load the fixed train/eval shards, or if steady-state updates through 10k are not faster than CR-DYN-0010. Model-quality criteria remain the same but are not attributed to preprocessing.

controlled_variable.name: dynamics_training_input_representation
values: CR-DYN-0010 raw uint8 RGB with frozen tokenizer encoder executed in every train step
CR-DYN-0011 deterministic float32 latent ArrayRecords encoded once before training

data.transition_alignment: latents[t]=tokenizer(raw_video[t]), actions[t]=action_t, rewards[t]=reward observed after action_t

compute.estimated_budget: One offline encoding pass followed by the unchanged 200,000-update dynamics budget; expected to be substantially shorter than the projected 13-hour raw-video run.
compute.shutdown_policy: Reuse only the existing A10. Run serially after CR-DYN-0010 is stopped with its evidence retained. Keep the existing instance timer and extend only if fewer than four hours remain.

success_criteria.rule: All 4,096 train and 512 eval latent records must preserve exact categorical actions, rewards, terminals, record order and raw-tree identity.
The latent dataloader must preserve CR-DYN-0010 reward-biased window selection and the 64/128, 10% long schedule.
Median steady-state throughput through 10,000 updates must be at least 1.25x the retained CR-DYN-0010 raw-video run.
The run must complete the unchanged 200,000-update model/optimizer protocol and terminal raw-RGB evaluations.
Quality and action thresholds match CR-DYN-0010, but any improvement is a model-training observation rather than a causal claim about offline preprocessing; direct visual review remains mandatory.
